signIn.intro: Enter your e-mail address. We send you a link that signs you in. There is no password.
signIn.privacy: The address is stored only once you use the link.
signIn.invalid: This is not an e-mail address. Check it and try again.
signIn.tooMany: Too many links were requested from here. Try again in an hour.
signIn.mailDown: The mail could not be sent. Try again later.
signIn.paused: New accounts are paused for now. If you already have one, we still send you a link.
signIn.passkeyFailed: The passkey did not sign you in. Use the e-mail link instead.
signIn.passkeyTooMany: Too many passkey sign-ins from here. Try again in an hour.

checkMail.body: If the address is right, a link is on its way. It works once, for 15 minutes.
checkMail.nothing: Nothing arrived? Look in your spam folder, or ask for a new link.

confirm.body: Sign in to Event Junkie with this link. The link then stops working.
confirm.missing: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the mail, or ask for a new one.
confirm.invalid: This link was already used or has expired. Ask for a new one.

page.exportHint: Everything stored about your account, as a JSON file.
page.deleteHint: Deletes your account and signs you out everywhere. This cannot be undone.
page.deleteConfirmBody: Your address and everything stored with it are deleted now. You can create a new account later with the same address.
page.failed: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.

follow.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
follow.tooMany: You follow 500 things already. Unfollow one first.

page.intro: Today's and upcoming events of what you follow and what you plan to attend, by date.
page.empty: You do not follow anything yet. Follow an artist, a venue or a promoter on their page, or start with one of these venues.
page.noneFiltered: Nothing you follow matches these filters.

followed.empty: You do not follow an artist, a venue or a promoter yet. Press Follow on their page.

search.open: See it on your Following page
search.datesDropped: The dates you picked are not saved: a saved search keeps only Today, This weekend or Next 7 days.
search.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
search.tooMany: You have 20 saved searches already. Delete one first.
search.signIn: Sign in to save this search

rsvp.label: Your plans for this event
rsvp.signIn: Sign in to save your plans
rsvp.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

page.intro: The events you are interested in or going to. Only you see them.
page.none: Nothing planned yet. Press Interested or Going on an event's page.

push.title: Notifications
push.intro: A push to this browser when an artist, venue or promoter you follow has a new date. Choose which ones with the bell on
push.on: Notifications are on in this browser.
push.off: Notifications are off in this browser.
push.homeScreen: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work only from the Home Screen. In Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen", and open Event Junkie from there.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
push.unavailable: Notifications are not available right now.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings. Allow them there to turn them on.
push.failed: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
push.tooMany: Notifications are on in 10 browsers already. Turn them off in one first.
push.bellHint: The bell sends a push for new dates to every browser where notifications are on. Turn them on for this browser
push.ringAll: The bell is off on the {count} you follow. Ring them, so each new date comes as a push? | The bell is off on one you follow. Ring it, so each new date comes as a push? | The bell is off on {count} you follow. Ring them all, so each new date comes as a push?
push.ringAllDone: No bell changed. | The bell is on for the one you follow. Change it on your Following page. | The bell is on for all {count}. Change single ones on your Following page.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: With a passkey you sign in on this device without waiting for a mail. Your device unlocks it with your fingerprint, face or PIN. The e-mail link still works.
passkeys.limit: This account has ten passkeys already. Delete one first.
passkeys.failed: That did not work. Try again.
